fiction_boundary.finding: Seldon's psychohistory is an in-universe fictional predictive science. Literary reference describes mass behavior and unawareness of the analysis as fictional assumptions;no numerical population threshold or operational law is certified from the accessible excerpt.
fiction_boundary.interpretation: Large synthetic N doesnot establish accurate real-world forecasts. Reflexive behavior,common shocks,nonstationarity,unobserved structure andmeasurement error remain real modeling limitations.
fiction_boundary.different_term: Do not conflate Asimovian psychohistory with historical/psychoanalytic study using the same term.

pentland_context.finding: The primary2009whitepaper describes phone-based proximity/communication measurement,including100phones in an MIT2004–2005study,anddiscusses privacy. These are bounded measured social contexts,not civilization-scale laws.
pentland_context.limits: Proximity isnot automatically influence;predictive association isnot randomized causal identification. Sampling,missing sensing,selection andconsent limits need explicit checking. No medical-performance claim orprivate trace imported here.

page_context.finding: Accessible material motivates comparing multiple explicit models;it doesnot supply an inspected complete computational chapter algorithm.
page_context.application: Use a separately sourced model plus an editorial no-influence baseline andscenario comparison. Neither model averaging norin-sample explanation automatically yields held-out predictive accuracy.

verified_quantitative_method.verified_summary: Binary agents observe a fraction of active neighbors and activate at or above their thresholds. Thresholds and degrees can be heterogeneous. The paper starts from small seeds,updates in random asynchronous order,and keeps activated nodes on. Its sparse random-graph analysis uses large-network/local-tree assumptions;it is not a finite social forecast certificate.
verified_quantitative_method.source_vs_proposal: The proposed synchronous finite graph convention is editorial andmust be named separately from the paper's random asynchronous schedule. The source doesnot provide empirical thresholds for this project.
verified_quantitative_method.access: Primary PMC/publisher access intermittently challenged/403;SNAP/NYU institutional article witnesses andprimary indexed Model Specification inspected. Berkeley witness has aJSTOR cover plus6article pages;no mirror byte equivalence attested.

proposed_model.state: a_i(t) in{0,1};fixed N;edge list defines neighbors;d_i=degree,m_i(t)=active-neighbor count.
proposed_model.update: a_i(t+1)=a_i(t) OR [d_i>0 AND m_i(t)/d_i>=phi_i]. Compute froma full copy of the prior round;no within-round influence leakage.
proposed_model.exact_boundary: Forphi_i=u/v,useinteger comparison m_i*v>=d_i*u,orprecomputedceil(d_i*u/v). No float tie tolerance.
proposed_model.isolated: Editorial convention:unseeded degree-zero nodes neveractivate,evenatphi0;initially seededisolates stayactive.
proposed_model.zero_threshold: Forpositive degree,phi0 permits spontaneous activation evenwith noseed. Do not conflate a zero threshold withzero transition probability.
proposed_model.initial: Fixed explicit seeds orBernoulli initial seeds underdeclared probabilityrho. Stochasticity initially comesfromthese seeds,not a fabricated per-contact transition law.
proposed_model.feedback: Neighbor states create nonlinear feedback. Thresholds remain fixed;this isnot an adaptive learning model.
proposed_model.conservation: active(t)+inactive(t)=N;active ismonotone. Stable/no-change state isabsorbing underthis fixed rule.
proposed_model.time: Rounds are model steps,not days orcalendar forecasts. Random-asynchronous visits/sweeps andsynchronous rounds are not interchangeable clock units.
proposed_model.interventions: First compare static graph,threshold orinitial-seed variants. Keep N/node identity constant forpaired experiments;reportedge edits separately fromchangingthresholds. Dynamic interventions/blocked-node denominator conventions are P1.

randomness_replay.proposal: Prefer reusing thealready documented xorshift32-v1 contract oranother fully specified generator without changing its prior contracts. Freeze independent vectors before52production;no52draws orsimulation run performed here.
randomness_replay.mapping: One initial uniform perreplicate andstable node ID,generated once andshared across scenarios withsameN/node identities;consume draws evenwhen fixed assignments override a node. No graph-dependent orstate-dependent draw consumption.
randomness_replay.comparison: Common uniforms create coupling byconstruction;they do not independently validate either model anddo not always reduce paired variance. Separate independent seeded streams need their own provenance.
randomness_replay.precision: Finite-state PRNG grid anddeterministic dependence mustbe disclosed. Ideal iid initial-seed moments are not a theorem about theactual pseudorandom stream.
randomness_replay.replay: Pin model/source/graph/threshold/seed/schema/code identities,exact threshold ties,output ordering andrawJSON/Markdown bytes before later release.

independent_fixture_plan.expected: For every finite binary state,active+inactive=N;N is fixed,not a demographic birth/death forecast.

Initial Bernoulli seed probability0 andstrictly positive thresholds produce no cascade;emptygraph prevents neighbor-driven activation. Candidate independent-transition model withp01=p10=0 preserves all states.
Seed probability1 makes all agents active at t0. Degree1neighbor withthreshold1 activates when its sole neighbor is active; threshold0 onpositive-degree nodes activates without seeds.
Irreversibly active agents remain active;all-active is absorbing. No new additions means a fixed point under the synchronous rule.
N1,noedges:unseeded stays0,seeded stays1. Proposed isolated-node convention forbids spontaneous adoption evenatthreshold0.
K4,one seed,threshold1/3 activates all at t1 by equality;threshold1/2 leaves one seed unchanged.
Freeze exact PRNG,seed type,replicate/node mapping anddraw order before production;one initial uniform pernode/run,including overridden nodes;no state-dependent stream consumption.

evaluation_limits.verification: Exact execution ofspecified mathematics mustbe independently tested later;this audit only authors expectations.
evaluation_limits.scenario: Counterfactual conditional simulation isnot observed causal efficacy.
evaluation_limits.calibration: Needs justified observed graph/parameters,source vintages,missingness andsampling assumptions;none fitted here.
evaluation_limits.prediction: Needs event/group/time held-out outcomes andhonest baselines;larger N/ensemble runs do not supply empirical skill.
evaluation_limits.uncertainty: ReportR andsample variance onlywhenR>1;R1 variance notestimable. Initial iid binomial moments do not apply tocorrelated post-cascade states. No automatic confidence intervals orcausal p-values.
evaluation_limits.pairing: For ideal iid run pairs,Var(mean(YA-YB))=[VarYA+VarYB-2Cov(YA,YB)]/R. Coupling isnot guaranteed variance reduction.
